Additionally, high leverage is evident from a debt-to-equity ratio of approximately 2.74 and a debt-to-assets ratio of about 73%, which are above levels associated with investment-grade ratings. Although the operating margin of 19.1% is solid, low asset turnover (approximately 4.95%) and weak return on assets (approximately 0.95% based on EBIT) suggest inefficiency and reduced capacity to service debt, placing the issuer in speculative grade territory.

DECISION: B+
